svg.title: MERFISH · img_001.tif · Reference and prediction agreement
svg.desc: First test image, separate retained run. Hungarian matching with a 3-pixel cutoff. 1259 matched, 17 unmatched predictions, 615 missed references. Shared min-to-99.8th-percentile contrast, full frame.
svg.text: Green: matched · Orange: unmatched · Purple: missed · F1 0.7994 · Separate retained run
